title: Implement deterministic Telegram interaction protocol
requirements: Add a pure TelegramInteractionMapper that accepts only an AcceptedTelegramUpdate and returns an immutable TelegramIntent carrying the exact validated ChannelContext, optional callback_query_id, a strict kind OPEN, HELP, RESET, SUBMIT, SELECT_SERVICE or TEXT_INPUT, and an immutable normalized payload. Revalidate that the context platform is TELEGRAM and reject all other objects or malformed accepted-result shapes with typed safe TelegramInteractionError codes without exposing input text.

Map complete private text commands /start, /help and /reset, with an optional syntactically valid @bot_username suffix, to OPEN, HELP and RESET. Commands are case-insensitive only in the command word; do not accept arguments, deep-link payloads, extra whitespace or lookalike prefixes as commands. Every other already-normalized non-command text becomes TEXT_INPUT with exact text preserved for later step-aware handling. A slash-prefixed unknown command returns UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND rather than becoming a name or business answer.

Define the only accepted callback_data protocol as ASCII v1:o, v1:h, v1:r, v1:u and v1:s:<catalog_version>:<option_ordinal>. Map the four fixed callbacks to OPEN, HELP, RESET and SUBMIT. For service selection require canonical decimal integers without signs or leading zeros, catalog_version in 1..2147483647 and option_ordinal in 0..2147483647; return SELECT_SERVICE with only these two integers. Reject a malformed known v1 shape as MALFORMED_CALLBACK and any unknown version/action as UNSUPPORTED_CALLBACK. Never accept a raw service_option_id, platform, sender, event or arbitrary JSON from callback data.

Preserve callback_query_id exactly so a later transport can acknowledge it. Do not call ChannelConversation, resolve catalog ordinals, parse requester/details fields, render human copy, mutate drafts, retain data, log inputs, load environment, add HTTP/SDK/persistence/delivery/retry behavior or perform external calls.

Add exhaustive pure tests for type/context/result validation, immutability, context and callback-id preservation, command cases/suffixes/unknowns/arguments/lookalikes, arbitrary text preservation, every fixed callback, canonical numeric service callbacks and every boundary/malformed/unsupported/spoof form. Copy this exact contract from primary .pipeline/TG-004-spec.json to tasks/specs/TG-004.json.
acceptance: Authenticated normalized Telegram input is converted into a small explicit intent vocabulary without interpreting free-form business fields or trusting callback business identifiers.
Service callbacks are compact, versioned and resolvable against a future live catalog without exceeding Telegram callback limits.
Focused interaction tests, Telegram update regression, complete project tests, scope and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted pure Telegram intent protocol over the reviewed authenticated update boundary, before orchestration and network transport.
